extracted.intended_audience: mechanical and multidisciplinary engineers, ASME members, and potential award applicants
extracted.subtask_description: Summary of ASME's Honors & Awards program: categories of awards, the types of achievements recognized, and notes about membership/eligibility. Serves as an overview for engineers considering nomination or application for ASME honors.

rubrics_metrics.name: General program purpose / recognition criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: ASME’s Honors & Awards program celebrates individuals who have made important contributions in various engineering disciplines. Awards recognize those who have made major achievements, presented groundbreaking papers or demonstrated a commitment of service to the Society.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Annual conferral by the ASME Committee on Honors (e.g., '2025 Awardees... Committee on Honors confers awards to over 70 individuals'). Use these broad categories—achievement, literature, and service—as primary bases for recognition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Achievement Awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Honors those who have made significant achievements in various engineering disciplines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targets individuals with notable technical, professional, or career accomplishments across engineering fields; typically awarded for measurable/significant achievements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Literature Awards
rubrics_metrics.description: For authors of outstanding papers on various engineering topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes excellence in scholarly or technical writing/papers; rewards originality, quality, and impact of published works.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service Awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards to honors dedicated voluntary service to ASME and Outstanding Student Section Advisors
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acknowledges volunteer commitment and service contributions to the Society, including exceptional support/advising of student sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Joint Awards
rubrics_metrics.description: ASME members may be eligible and qualified to receive various other engineering awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates collaboration or shared-award arrangements with other societies/organizations; membership can affect eligibility for these joint recognitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unit Awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Honors, awards, and scholarships offered by ASME Groups, Sections or Committees
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards administered at the unit (group/section/committee) level, including scholarships and local honors—may have unit-specific criteria and processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellows (Membership Grade of Distinction)
rubrics_metrics.description: A Membership Grade of Distinction and outstanding achievements
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fellow grade recognizes outstanding achievement and is a membership distinction; implies both demonstrated excellence and meeting membership-grade requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership & eligibility implication
rubrics_metrics.description: Becoming an ASME Member: Joining ASME is the most important connection a current or future Mechanical Engineer can make. ASME members may be eligible and qualified to receive various other engineering awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Membership provides benefits and may be tied to eligibility for some awards; consider membership status when assessing qualification for specific honors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award information & intent
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards and other honors to celebrate and encourage contributions to engineering
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program aims both to celebrate past contributions and encourage ongoing contributions to the engineering profession; consult specific award pages for detailed nomination requirements and criteria.
